name: Samsic
verdict: French family-owned services group (Samsic Facility, Samsic RH, Samsic Airport), founded in 1986 by Christian Roulleau; main sponsor of Stade Rennais since 2004. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: family-owned private group (registry: SAS, SIREN 403227796, Rennes, chaired by Thierry Geffroy); the founder's motto and the company's own vision page confirm family ownership. No state or fund stake found → none.
